# artifactapi_settings (Resource)

Manages the singleton ArtifactAPI global settings overrides. Only one instance should exist per server; overrides set outside Terraform on unset attributes are cleared on apply, and destroying it reverts every setting to the server's environment defaults.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Global server settings overrides; there is one per server. Unset
# attributes clear their override (including ones set outside Terraform)
# and use the server's environment defaults; destroying the resource
# reverts every setting to them.
resource "artifactapi_settings" "this" {
  s3_health_up_threshold   = 2
  s3_health_down_threshold = 5
  s3_health_interval_ms    = 5000
  s3_health_timeout_ms     = 2000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `s3_health_down_threshold` (Number) Consecutive failed S3 health probes before the backend is marked down. Must be between 1 and 100. Unset clears the override, reverting to the server's environment default.
- `s3_health_interval_ms` (Number) Interval between S3 health probes, in milliseconds. Must be between 500 and 3600000. Unset clears the override, reverting to the server's environment default.
- `s3_health_timeout_ms` (Number) Timeout of each S3 health probe, in milliseconds; must be shorter than s3_health_interval_ms. When s3_health_interval_ms is unset, this is checked against the server's default interval only at apply. Must be at least 100. Unset clears the override, reverting to the server's environment default.
- `s3_health_up_threshold` (Number) Consecutive successful S3 health probes before the backend is marked up. Must be between 1 and 100. Unset clears the override, reverting to the server's environment default.

### Read-Only

- `effective` (Attributes) Settings the server is running with: each override, or the environment default where unset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective))
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of the singleton, always "settings".

<a id="nestedatt--effective"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective`

Read-Only:

- `s3_health_down_threshold` (Number) Effective S3 health down threshold.
- `s3_health_interval_ms` (Number) Effective S3 health probe interval, in milliseconds.
- `s3_health_timeout_ms` (Number) Effective S3 health probe timeout, in milliseconds.
- `s3_health_up_threshold` (Number) Effective S3 health up threshold.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The settings are a singleton; any ID imports them.
terraform import artifactapi_settings.this settings
```
